title: Fanin bound for unfolded circuits
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, whose gates have distinct argument vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. Suppose every gate has at most $k$ arguments. For every fuel bound, polarity, and vertex $v<n+|C.	ext{gates}|$, the maximum fanin of the tree obtained by unfolding $v$ is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is well formed: each gate has distinct argument vertices and every NOT gate has exactly one argument
